 Bryce Young Stats vs. Saints: Career Stats & Game Logs
 BetMGM 
 Nov 12, 2026, 3:15 PM 
 min read 
 (John Bazemore/AP Photo) 
 Bryce Young and the Carolina Panthers face the New Orleans Saints in Week 10. This will be Young’s 7th career appearance against the Saints.
 Bryce Young vs. Saints: Career Stats
 Games: 6
 Passing Yards: 909
 Passing TDs: 3
 Interceptions: 4
 Passing Yards/Game: 151.5
 TDs/Game: 0.5
 INTs/Game: 0.7
 Bryce Young vs. Saints: Game Logs
 Dec. 14, 2025 – Panthers vs. Saints
 Young completed 15 of 24 passes for 163 yards, 1 touchdown, and 0 interceptions.
 Nov. 9, 2025 – Panthers vs. Saints
 Young completed 17 of 25 passes for 124 yards, 0 touchdowns, and 1 interception.
 Nov. 3, 2024 – Panthers vs. Saints
 Young completed 16 of 26 passes for 171 yards, 1 touchdown, and 1 interception.
 Sept. 8, 2024 – Panthers vs. Saints
 Young completed 13 of 30 passes for 161 yards, 0 touchdowns, and 2 interceptions.
 Dec. 10, 2023 – Panthers vs. Saints
 Young completed 13 of 36 passes for 137 yards, 0 touchdowns, and 0 interceptions.
 Sept. 18, 2023 – Panthers vs. Saints
 Young completed 22 of 33 passes for 153 yards, 1 touchdown, and 0 interceptions.
